facts.fact: 小丑学校第二天九点前，一百名学生在旧体操房就座。
facts.anchor: It’s one minute before nine and they are all seated, all one hundred of them, in the old gymnastics room.

facts.fact: Magdalena 教的核心动作理论：戏剧里一切都能还原成推或拉。
facts.anchor: everything can be reduced to a push or a pull

facts.fact: Elise 自我说服：渴望不是爱，是另一种东西（好奇）。
facts.anchor: Longing is not love, she assures herself—it is a separate thing.

facts.fact: 水瓶被 Magdalena 羞辱后，Elise 把它（家里的金属瓶）扔进垃圾桶。
facts.anchor: Instead of dying, Elise throws the bottle—metal, from home, not a plastic grocery store one—into the garbage.

facts.fact: 在酒吧她拿出笔记本，请求画 Aya 的速写。
facts.anchor: She has an idea. She pulls her notebook and pen out of her backpack

facts.fact: Aya 用「她」透露自己的初恋是一个女人（舞者），单字成段。
给 Max 回信时她不知如何落款，既无 love 也无 xo。
facts.anchor: She isn’t sure how to sign off so she leaves it at that. No love, no xo

facts.fact: Catherine 被假房东骗走六千欧，公寓根本不存在，拎着行李住进女儿房间。
